title: Maul
description:
Deal 5 damage twice.
Increase the damage of ALL Maul cards by 1 this combat.
upgraded_description:
Deal 6 damage twice.
Increase the damage of ALL Maul cards by 2 this combat.
notes: When played, Maul deals damage twice to the target and buffs all other Maul cards in your hand/deck by increasing their base damage for the rest of combat. This effect stacks with each Maul that is played.
